ideas.pitch: An automated local intelligence gathering tool tailored for Jeopardy CTF OSINT challenges to map digital footprints and social graphs quickly.
ideas.title: CTF-Forge OSINT Grapher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at one of the core competition domains of Zephyr CTF 2026, offering immediate practical utility for participants and scoring high on speed and accuracy.

ideas.pitch: A rapid cryptographic analysis assistant designed to identify cipher types, automated padding oracle checks, and common RSA flaws for CTF challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoBreak Helper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a challenging technical domain in the event where manual calculation slows down competitors, giving an edge through automated script generation.

ideas.pitch: An image and audio forensics utility that applies Least Significant Bit analysis, frequency spectrum inspection, and metadata diffing to find hidden flags.
ideas.title: StegoScope AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Steganography challenges often waste valuable competition hours; a unified tool with visual inspectors directly targets high-friction CTF tasks.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight binary analysis wrapper providing automated strings extraction, dynamic symbol hooking summaries, and heuristic vulnerability flagging for reverse engineering.
ideas.title: BinInspect RE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Reverse engineering requires deep focus; a streamlined wrapper that cuts down repetitive assembly analysis fits the Jeopardy CTF format perfectly.

ideas.pitch: A localized vulnerability scanner configured specifically to detect common CTF web flaws like SQLi, SSTI, and insecure deserialization payloads.
ideas.title: WebExploit Scanner Mini
ideas.why_it_could_win: Web exploitation is a staple of Jeopardy CTF events, and having a localized, fast assessment script template saves teams precious minutes during the contest.
